title: FloodWatch.PH: open-source observed flood extent and recurrence mapping from satellite data
description: Open-source two-track system for measuring observed flood extent and flood recurrence from public satellite data over the Philippines. Track A applies classical Sentinel-1 SAR Otsu change detection (parameter-free, no training) to produce per-timestep flood-extent GeoJSON for real typhoon events, validated against the Global Flood Database (GFD event 4300, Koppu/Lando 2015). Track B trains a logistic-regression head on frozen Google AlphaEarth Satellite Embedding V1 (64-dim, CC-BY-4.0, produced by Google and Google DeepMind) with Platt-sigmoid calibration on an event-disjoint holdout to classify per-pixel flood recurrence proneness across the Philippines GFD event history (2002-2017). The build is bit-exact reproducible from a committed ~1 MB embeddings cache via deterministic sklearn, no GPU, approximately 30 seconds. Metrics are reported separately per track; they are never averaged.
